# 01. Viewport camera math

Conventions: right-handed, Y up. `eye`, `pivot`, `distance`, `fov_y` (rad), `H` viewport height (px). `forward = normalize(pivot - eye)`, `right = normalize(forward × Y)`, `up = right × forward`.

## 1. Orbit
State: `yaw`, `pitch`, `pivot`, `distance`.
```
yaw   += -dx * k_rot                 ; k_rot ≈ 0.3°/px (in radians: 0.0052)
pitch  = clamp(pitch - dy * k_rot, -89°, +89°)
forward = (cos(pitch)·sin(yaw), -sin(pitch), cos(pitch)·cos(yaw))   ; yaw=0 looks toward +Z
eye     = pivot - forward * distance
```
Orientation = look-at(eye → pivot, Y). Clamp prevents gimbal flip at ±90°.

## 2. Depth-synchronised pan (1:1)
World units per pixel at the pivot plane: `u = 2 · distance · tan(fov_y/2) / H`.
```
delta_world = (-right * dx + up * dy) * u
pivot += delta_world ; eye += delta_world
```
(dx,dy in px, screen y grows downward — sign above already accounts for it.)

## 3. Zoom
Exponential: `distance *= exp(-scroll * zoom_rate)`; `zoom_rate ≈ 0.15` per wheel notch (Shift ×3 alt). Clamp `distance ∈ [0.1, 5000]`.
Cursor-directed zoom: cast ray `r(t)=o+t·d` through cursor, hit point `P` on heightfield (doc 03); if hit:
```
eye'   = eye + (P - eye) * (1 - exp(-scroll * zoom_rate))
pivot' = eye' + forward * |P - eye'|          ; keeps look direction
```
else fall back to pivot-directed zoom. Trackpad/drag zoom: `scale = 1 + delta * 0.015`, with `|delta| ≥ 1e-4`.

## 4. Free flight (RMB held)
Look: same as orbit rotation but about `eye` (pivot recomputed after).
Move: `wish = forward*(W−S) + right*(D−A) + Y*(E−Q)`, `normalize_or_zero`.
Base speed `v0 = 9 m/s` (default); wheel during flight: `v0 *= exp(scroll * 0.1)`, clamp `[0.1, 500]`.
Shift acceleration (non-linear ramp): while Shift held, speed target
```
v_target(t+dt) = v_target(t) * a^dt        ; a = accel_param + 1  (offset avoids a<1), v_target(0)=v0
```
Shift released: `v_target = v0`.
Smoothing / velocity damping:
```
vel  = lerp(vel, wish * v_target, 1 - exp(-dt / tau))     ; tau ≈ 0.08 s
eye += vel * dt
```
On exit: `pivot = eye + forward * distance`.

## 5. Focus (F)
Given AABB of selection with centre `c`, half-extents `h`: `radius = |h|`.
```
target_distance = max(radius / sin(fov_y/2), 2.0)
target_pivot    = c
```
Smoothing per frame: `s = 1 - exp(-dt / 0.12)`; `pivot = lerp(pivot, target_pivot, s)`; `distance = lerp(distance, target_distance, s)`; stop when `|Δpivot| < 1e-3` and `|Δdistance| < 1e-3`.
# 02. 3D gizmo projection & drag math

Ray: `R(t) = o + t·d`, `|d|=1`. `view_dir` = camera forward. `cam_forward` = same.

## 1. Constant screen size
```
handle_size = |(eye - origin) · cam_forward| * tan(fov_y/2) * 0.16
```
All gizmo geometry (arrow length, ring radius, plane quad offset) is `handle_size * k`. Pick tolerance on axes ≈ `0.1 * handle_size`.

## 2. 1D axis drag (unit axis `a`, origin `O`)
Helper plane through `O`: `n = normalize_or_zero((a × view_dir) × a)` (plane contains `a`, faces camera as much as possible).
Parameter along axis of a ray hit:
```
t_hit = (o + s·d - O) · a ,  s = ((O - o)·n) / (d·n)
```
Dead zone: if `|a · view_dir| > 0.96` (looking along the axis, `n≈0`), use screen-space fallback: project `O` and `O+a` to pixels `p0,p1`; `t = ((mouse - p0)·(p1-p0)) / |p1-p0|² * 1` (world units per unit of that projected segment).
Grab offset at click: `grab_offset = t_hit_initial - t_origin` (with `t_origin = 0`). During drag:
```
new_pos = O_start + a * (t_hit_curr - grab_offset)
```
Optional snap: `round(value/step)*step`.

## 3. 2D plane drag (plane normal `n`, plane axes `u,v`)
Intersection: `s = ((O - o)·n) / (d·n)`, valid if `s > 0`.
Reject grazing: if `|n · view_dir| < 0.08` ⇒ no update (keep last position).
```
grab = P_hit_initial - O_start
new_pos = P_hit_curr - grab          ; planes XY (n=Z), XZ (n=Y), YZ (n=X)
```

## 4. Rotation disc (axis `a`, centre `O`)
Ring plane: normal `a`, through `O`. Hit point `P` ⇒ `v = normalize(P - O)`.
Degenerate: if `|a · view_dir| > 0.999`, ring is face-on: use the same plane intersection (valid). If edge-on (`|a · view_dir| < 0.08`) use tangent drag: `angle += (mouse_delta · screen_tangent) * 0.5°/px`.
```
angle = atan2( a · (v_start × v_curr),  v_start · v_curr )
```
Ctrl held: `angle = round(angle / 15°) * 15°`.
Accumulated rotation: `q = Quat(a, angle) * q_start` (no wrap loss: sum signed deltas between frames, wrap each into `(-π, π]`).
Grab zone: ring radius ± `0.3 * handle_size * 0.1`.
# 04. Procedural terrain, erosion, splatmap, brushes

Grid `N×N`, world size `S`, cell `c=S/(N-1)`. `smoothstep(a,b,x)=t²(3-2t)`, `t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1)`.

## 1. Valley height field
Coordinates `p=(x,z)/S ∈ [-0.5,0.5]²`, `r=|p|·2`.
fBm with analytic derivatives: `fbm(p)=Σ_{i<O} g^i · n(f^i p)`, `O=6, f=2.0, g=0.5`; derivative `∇fbm` accumulated as `Σ g^i f^i ∇n`.
Domain warp: `q = p + A · (fbm(p+o1), fbm(p+o2))` with `A≈0.12`; derivative-damped octaves: `amp_i /= 1 + |∇sum|²`.
```
base   = 0.5 + 0.5*fbm(q)
ring   = smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, r)                 ; mountain ring at map edge
h      = base*H_base + ring*H_mount*(0.6+0.4*fbm(2q))
lake   : d=|p - lake_center|*S ; bowl = 1 - smoothstep(0, lake_radius, d)
         h -= bowl*lake_depth                       ; smooth bowl
shelf  : shallow = smoothstep(lake_radius*1.0, lake_radius*1.35, d); h = lerp(h_lake_floor+0.3, h, shallow)
camp   : w = 1 - smoothstep(camp_r, camp_r*1.6, |p - camp_center|*S) ; h = lerp(h, h_camp, w)   ; flat clearing
path   : centreline x_c(z)= x0 + A_p sin(k z + φ) ; dd=|x - x_c|; w = 1 - smoothstep(wp, 2wp, dd); h = lerp(h, h_path, 0.7w)
```
Heights are clamped `[0, H_max]`.

## 2. Droplet hydraulic erosion (per droplet)
Params: inertia `ι=0.05`, capacity `K_c=4`, min slope `0.01`, erode `K_e=0.3`, deposit `K_d=0.3`, evaporate `K_v=0.01`, gravity `g=4`, life 30 steps.
State `pos, dir, speed=1, water=1, sediment=0`.
```
grad = bilinear gradient of h at pos
dir  = dir*ι - grad*(1-ι) ; normalise ; pos += dir
Δh   = h_new - h_old
cap  = max(-Δh, min_slope) * speed * water * K_c
if sediment > cap or Δh > 0:
     dep = Δh>0 ? min(Δh, sediment) : (sediment-cap)*K_d ; sediment -= dep ; h[pos] += dep (bilinear weights)
else:
     ero = min((cap-sediment)*K_e, -Δh) ; h[pos] -= ero (brush radius 3) ; sediment += ero
speed = sqrt(max(speed² + Δh*g, 0)) ; water *= (1-K_v)
```

# 01. Viewport camera math

Conventions: right-handed, Y up. `eye`, `pivot`, `distance`, `fov_y` (rad), `H` viewport height (px). `forward = normalize(pivot - eye)`, `right = normalize(forward × Y)`, `up = right × forward`.

State: `yaw`, `pitch`, `pivot`, `distance`.
```

pitch  = clamp(pitch - dy * k_rot, -89°, +89°)
forward = (cos(pitch)·sin(yaw), -sin(pitch), cos(pitch)·cos(yaw))   ; yaw=0 looks toward +Z
eye     = pivot - forward * distance
```
Orientation = look-at(eye → pivot, Y). Clamp prevents gimbal flip at ±90°.

## 2. Depth-synchronised pan (1:1)
World units per pixel at the pivot plane: `u = 2 · distance · tan(fov_y/2) / H`.
```

pivot += delta_world ; eye += delta_world
```
(dx,dy in px, screen y grows downward — sign above already accounts for it.)

Exponential: `distance *= exp(-scroll * zoom_rate)`; `zoom_rate ≈ 0.15` per wheel notch (Shift ×3 alt). Clamp `distance ∈ [0.1, 5000]`.

```

```

Look: same as orbit rotation but about `eye` (pivot recomputed after).
